title: List-ID routing: mailing list mail to newsgroup articles
description: After authentication, inspect accepted message headers for List-ID (RFC 2919, syntax: <list-name.list-host>). If present: parse the List-ID value, look up configured newsgroup mapping table (List-ID pattern → newsgroup name). Also support auto-derive convention: dots in list-name become dots in group name, e.g. <rust-users.lists.rust-lang.org> → misc.lists.rust-lang.rust-users (configurable convention). Synthesize a Newsgroups: header with the resolved group name. Check msgid_map for duplicate by Message-ID before storing — mailing lists deliver the same message to multiple local recipients, store only once. Convert the RFC 5322 message bytes into an article and write via the existing article write path (same code path as NNTP POST): write raw bytes to block store, insert into msgid_map, assign article number, update overview index. Messages with a List-ID header skip the Sieve pipeline entirely and never touch user mailboxes. Configuration: list of {list_id_pattern, newsgroup_name} rules in smtp.toml; wildcard support (e.g. *.lists.rust-lang.org → misc.lists.rust-lang.*).
